title: 广播与 keepdims：去中心化无手工升维
expected_output:
mean shape = (1, 5)
centered shape = (100, 5)
centered col means ~0 = True
manual broadcast works = True
code:
import numpy as np
x = np.random.default_rng(0).normal(size=(100, 5))
mean = x.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
print("mean shape =", mean.shape)
centered = x - mean
print("centered shape =", centered.shape)
print("centered col means ~0 =", np.allclose(centered.mean(axis=0), 0, atol=1e-10))
mean2 = x.mean(axis=0)
print("manual broadcast works =", x.shape[1] == mean2.shape[0])
